title: Glowing television
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- TV body -->
  <rect x='12' y='20' width='76' height='56' rx='8' fill='#5a4a8a'/>
  <!-- TV body lighter top edge -->
  <rect x='12' y='20' width='76' height='10' rx='8' fill='#7a6aaa'/>
  <!-- Screen glow halo -->
  <rect x='20' y='30' width='60' height='38' rx='4' fill='#2a3a5a'/>
  <!-- Screen -->
  <rect x='22' y='32' width='56' height='34' rx='3' fill='#4a8aff'/>
  <!-- Screen brighter center glow -->
  <rect x='28' y='36' width='44' height='26' rx='2' fill='#7ab8ff'/>
  <!-- Screen highlight -->
  <rect x='32' y='40' width='18' height='10' rx='2' fill='#c8e8ff' opacity='0.8'/>
  <!-- Scanline effect -->
  <line x1='24' y1='44' x2='76' y2='44' stroke='#5a9aff' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.6'/>
  <line x1='24' y1='50' x2='76' y2='50' stroke='#5a9aff' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.6'/>
  <line x1='24' y1='56' x2='76' y2='56' stroke='#5a9aff' stroke-width='1' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- Antenna left -->
  <line x1='34' y1='20' x2='26' y2='6' stroke='#9a8acc' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='26' cy='6' r='3' fill='#ffdd44'/>
  <!-- Antenna right -->
  <line x1='66' y1='20' x2='74' y2='6' stroke='#9a8acc' stroke-width='3' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <circle cx='74' cy='6' r='3' fill='#ffdd44'/>
  <!-- Knobs -->
  <circle cx='79' cy='42' r='4' fill='#ff8844'/>
  <circle cx='79' cy='42' r='2' fill='#ffcc88'/>
  <circle cx='79' cy='54' r='4' fill='#44dd88'/>
  <circle cx='79' cy='54' r='2' fill='#aaffcc'/>
  <!-- Legs -->
  <rect x='28' y='76' width='6' height='10' rx='2' fill='#4a3a7a'/>
  <rect x='66' y='76' width='6' height='10' rx='2' fill='#4a3a7a'/>
  <!-- Leg feet -->
  <rect x='24' y='84' width='14' height='4' rx='2' fill='#6a5aaa'/>
  <rect x='62' y='84' width='14' height='4' rx='2' fill='#6a5aaa'/>
  <!-- Sparkles around screen -->
  <circle cx='12' cy='16' r='2' fill='#ffff88' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='88' cy='14' r='2' fill='#ffff88' opacity='0.9'/>
  <circle cx='8' cy='40' r='1.5' fill='#ffff88' opacity='0.7'/>
  <circle cx='92' cy='38' r='1.5' fill='#ffff88' opacity='0.7'/>
</svg>
